value.summary: The change renames the module alias `oh` from `openhuman_core::openhuman` to `openhuman_core`, which is a simplification of the import path. This does not introduce any new untrusted input, authentication/authorisation changes, network or subprocess calls, deserialization of untrusted data, path traversal, secrets, dependency changes, or widened permissions. The deterministic scanners have already run and found no issues. The change appears safe and introduces no security problems.
